payroll.title: Payroll Management
payroll.subtitle: Manage payroll, track returns, and monitor compliance adjustments
payroll.overviewHelp: Use Payroll Report to load a month with working days from attendance and leave from approved requests, paste a punch log when sync fails, and export the styled Excel. Use Reports for quick Excel export.
payroll.reportIntro: Pick a month and year — a saved payroll loads automatically if one exists, otherwise it builds from attendance and leave. Upload one or more attendance PDFs (or paste punch log text) to generate working days, then Save Payroll or Save & Send for Approval. The table is read-only.
